name: Relevium Call Topics
description: Configurable call topic catalog. The AI must pick exactly one active topic id. Edit call_topics/current in Firestore (or this file + seed) to evolve labels and classification guidance.

topics.label: Scheduling
topics.description: Appointments: booking, rescheduling, canceling, confirming, waitlist, or arrival/check-in logistics.

topics.label: Billing
topics.description: Patient balances, invoices, payment plans, statements, collections, or charges for services already rendered.

topics.label: Insurance
topics.description: Coverage verification, benefits, prior auth status, claim issues, referrals required by payer, or insurance card updates.

topics.label: Prescription / refill
topics.description: Medication refill requests, pharmacy questions, controlled-substance refill process, or prescription pickup status.

topics.label: Clinical question
topics.description: Symptoms, treatment questions, procedure follow-up, pain concerns, or clinical advice triage (non-emergency).

topics.label: Referral
topics.description: Incoming/outgoing specialist referrals, referral paperwork, or coordinating care with another provider.

topics.label: Records & forms
topics.description: Medical records requests, forms, disability paperwork, imaging results pickup, or release-of-information.

topics.label: New patient
topics.description: First-time callers establishing care, new-patient packets, or onboarding before a first appointment.

topics.label: Other
topics.description: Use only when the call does not clearly fit another active topic. Prefer a more specific topic when reasonable.
